headline.title: Google DeepMind and A24 announce first-of-its-kind research partnership
headline.summary: Google DeepMind has partnered with A24 to explore the intersection of artificial intelligence and film production. This collaboration aims to leverage AI technology to enhance storytelling and creative processes in the film industry.

articles.title: The only AI glossary you’ll need this year
articles.summary: This article provides a comprehensive glossary of essential AI terminology, helping readers navigate the increasing complexity of language associated with artificial intelligence. It includes definitions of key terms and phrases that have emerged alongside the growth of AI technology.

articles.title: The browser wars aren’t about search anymore — here are the best alternatives to Chrome and Safari
articles.summary: The article provides an overview of various alternative web browsers that are emerging to compete with dominant players like Chrome and Safari. It highlights the features and benefits of these alternatives, emphasizing the evolving landscape of web browsing.

articles.title: Pragmatic FDT, and predictors as game theory
articles.summary: A recent article critiques Functional Decision Theory (FDT), highlighting a divide between its proponents and the skepticism prevalent among academic decision theorists. The author references Bentham's Bulldog's argument that the limited acceptance of FDT among academics underscores its controversial status in the field of decision theory.

articles.title: A behind-the-scenes look at Midjourney’s medical scanner leaves many questions unanswered
articles.summary: Midjourney has unveiled a behind-the-scenes video of its dunk-tank ultrasound scanner, which aims to provide affordable and detailed medical imaging without radiation. However, the company has yet to provide substantial evidence of the scanner's effectiveness.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unionization Talks Are Off to a Rocky Start
articles.summary: Google DeepMind employees expressed dissatisfaction during recent negotiations, citing a lack of meaningful engagement from executives regarding unionization efforts. The talks have faced challenges as workers seek to address their concerns about the unionization process.

articles.title: Anthropic wants to develop its own drugs
articles.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Science, an AI workbench designed for scientists that integrates various tools and datasets into a single platform while generating figures and visuals. This announcement was made during the "The Briefing: AI for Science" event, highlighting the company's ongoing efforts to expand its influence in the scientific community.

articles.title: Mark Zuckerberg tells staff that AI agents haven’t progressed as quickly as he’d hoped
articles.summary: During an internal meeting, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg expressed disappointment that the company's AI development has not progressed as rapidly as he had hoped. He emphasized the need for continued focus and improvement in AI efforts.
